meaning: Free-space frequency-normalized conducted link-budget proxy. Equal antenna gains; no loss or fade margin is subtracted from individual curves.
frontier: Fastest nominal rate among sampled settings satisfying B_ref915 >= required path budget. Within each family only; spectrum occupancy and energy are not optimization dimensions in this plot.
line_interpretation: Step transitions select among sampled settings. They do not interpolate nonexistent modes or claim the sample is exhaustive.

packet_metadata.title: Selected verified LR2021 LoRa and FLRC operating points

document.title: LR2021/LR2022/LR2012 Datasheet
document.version_caveat: The current Semtech product page lists revision 2.2; these numerical points were verified against the accessible revision 2.1.

scope.description: All points from the previously reported verified sample matrices, not the complete supported configuration space.
scope.lora_2400_missing_bandwidths_note: No inferred sensitivities for 125 or 250 kHz at 2.4 GHz. Use the actual tabulated bandwidths in this dataset.

rate_assumptions.lora_rate_interpretation: Nominal bitrate, not measured payload throughput. Preamble, header, CRC, finite-packet effects, low-data-rate optimization (LDRO), MAC scheduling, acknowledgements and retransmissions are excluded.
rate_assumptions.flrc_rate_interpretation: Coding-adjusted PHY rate before packet and MAC overhead. The advertised 2.6 Mbps maximum uses CR=1; that uncoded configuration is not included here.

sensitivity_test_criteria.general: Manufacturer reference-design typical sensitivity, with G13 and rx_boost=7 where tabulated. Not measured end-to-end application thresholds.
sensitivity_test_criteria.general_rf_conditions: Datasheet general conditions specify the LF reference design around 915/869 MHz and HF around 2.45 GHz, SIMO power and no RF shield. Dataset labels 915 and 2400 MHz identify the intended bands.
sensitivity_test_criteria.lora_915: Table 3-17: 1% packet error rate, 64-byte payload; CR4/5, G13, rx_boost=7.
sensitivity_test_criteria.lora_2400: Table 3-18 title specifies 64-byte payload, but adjacent introductory text inconsistently says both 64B and 20 Bytes at 1% PER. This ambiguity is retained rather than silently resolved. G13, rx_boost=7.
sensitivity_test_criteria.flrc_915: Table 3-12: 1% packet error rate; CR3/4, G13, rx_boost=7. The table introduction does not specify a packet length.
sensitivity_test_criteria.flrc_2400: Table 3-13: 1% packet error rate, 31-byte packets; CR3/4, G13, rx_boost=7.
sensitivity_test_criteria.cross_mode_comparison_caution: Packet lengths and test criteria are not perfectly uniform across these tables or across other radio manufacturers.

power_and_bandwidth_assumptions.tx_dbm_interpretation: Maximum listed bare-chip transmit capability: +22 dBm sub-GHz and +12 dBm at 2.4 GHz. These are scenario assumptions, not a determination of permitted EIRP or module output.
power_and_bandwidth_assumptions.antenna_and_system_losses: Antenna gain, feed loss, implementation loss, interference and fade margin are not included.
power_and_bandwidth_assumptions.flrc_bandwidth_caveat: Use revised modem bandwidths from Table 18-1 (307/571/1333/2666 kHz). The sensitivity tables retain older rounded bandwidth labels for some settings. These are modem configuration bandwidths, not guaranteed occupied-spectrum widths or channel separation rules.

plot_guidance.interpretation: A fixed-antenna-gain free-space frequency-normalized link-budget proxy. It is not a measured distance or terrain propagation prediction.
plot_guidance.pareto_caution: A rate-versus-normalized-budget frontier omits bandwidth occupancy, spectrum scarcity, power consumption, latency, interference and actual packet goodput. A frontier of this dataset is a frontier of selected settings only.

wifi_metadata.purpose: Illustrative conducted PHY operating points for a normalized link-budget/rate frontier. Not measured mesh goodput, field range, or hardware recommendations.
wifi_metadata.frequency_note: Requested representative band centers, not a claim that each channel width uses exactly this legal center. Use the actual permitted channel in implementation.

tests.halow_256B_10pct: 10% packet error rate, 256-byte packets, VBAT=VBAT_TX=3.3 V, 25 C; receiver table does not explicitly state guard interval. All plotted rates deliberately use long GI.
tests.wifi_4096B_10pct: 10% packet error rate, 4096-octet PSDU, 800 ns GI, non-STBC, typical chip-port sensitivity; normal non-LDPC-specific table chosen.

caveats: PHY rates exclude preambles, headers, contention, acknowledgements, retransmissions, routing overhead and half-duplex forwarding.
HaLow and Wi-Fi receiver test packet lengths differ. Their nominal sensitivity figures are not a common-PER/common-packet controlled comparison.
HaLow TX values are measured at the module antenna pin and explicitly do not include regional or band-edge regulatory backoffs.

Wi-Fi values are at the chip port and exclude external front-end/board losses. Section 15.1 identifies WLAN RF values as design goals subject to characterization; typical values are not guaranteed limits.

Wi-Fi TX values are modulation/MCS examples, not a full per-channel power table. Mapping the generic OFDM BPSK power to HT/VHT MCS0 is an explicit model assumption; no TX maxima are invented for omitted MCS1-6 or MCS8.

Not every supported width/MCS can be independently switched on every packet in every mesh implementation. Rate adaptation operates within negotiated/configured radio and peer capabilities; changing the BSS operating channel/primary channel requires coordination.
Single stream, equal antenna gain, no implementation loss or fade margin assumed for a normalized comparison. No distance is guaranteed.
CYW43455 is an illustrative PHY comparator, not a recommendation that a particular module/driver supports 802.11s or simultaneous 2.4/5 GHz operation.

HaLow long-GI rates are calculated exactly from 24/52/108/234 data subcarriers and 40 us OFDM symbol duration. The manufacturer's printed PHY-rate column is rounded and mostly reflects short GI; its RX/TX matrices are retained by mode.
Raw source contains no band-specific frequency sensitivity sweep; representative centers do not imply characterization at those exact centers.

five_mile_reference.caution: Illustrative unobstructed free-space geometry with 0 dBi antennas and no additional loss. Not a range guarantee, propagation survey or radio-horizon model.
